title: kehti thi sakina kya baba nahi ayenge
body:
kehti thi sakina kya baba nahi aayenge
ab shimr satayega baba nahi ayenge
baba mujhe nind ayegi hargiz nahi tanha
jalti ye zamee'n aur kaha aap ka seena
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman me mere aag lagi jalte hai qaime aur pyas ki shiddat ko badha dete hai shole
pani kahan milega
bin apke baba mai bhala kaise jiungi
asghar ko rakha paas hui mujhse judaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham bhi rulayega
baba mujhe godi me utha lijiye aakar
qoo'n kaanou se behta hai mere chin gaye gouhar
mujh par hai sitam kaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
is des me purse ke hai andaaz niraale
zalim mujhe maare hai tamachou pa tamache
har gaam par hai rona
zalim phupi amma ki rida le gaye aakar
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai sabhi bibiya hai sabke khule sar
hum hogaye beparda
chayi hai yateemi ki bala sar pe jo mere
ghera hai andherou ne mujhe sham se pehle
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dardo gham hai sehna
abbas chacha jaan lahu me hai nahaye
be dast alamdar hai kis tarha wo aaye
dil toot gaya mera
